items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: And then the same Clement Turblin that plays trombone around at the paddock. Well, he was on the show, too.

ctx.x: Well, Joe Snayee, he died. Well, he was a trumpet player. Well, he left us about a week before that. And then the same Clement Turblin that plays trombone around at the paddock. Well, he was on the show, too. And he left. He and Joe left us together. They left in Memphis, you see, and came on home. You were heading south then? We were heading south. In other words, we was going to end up in Mississippi, and then we were going to leave from there and go back to North Carolina, going to Fayetteville for winter…
And you say, Bessie just sang in the concert then.
